deficiencies.description: The rewrite states that the slice through a tumour 'illustrates this', linking the stained slice of the tumour to the explanting of tumours mentioned in the preceding sentence. The original text only says that the slice and stain show morphology, without stating that it illustrates explanting.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So the other thing to appreciate is that when, if you like, biologists are studying tumors, often they will explant the tumor. Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A slice through a tumour, with a stain to show the morphology, illustrates this [FIGURE].
